notes: All five Sloane conjectures hold. Invariant: for n >= 5 row n = {p prime: 2p in row n-1} plus the next composites after R_{n-1}; it propagates whenever l_{n-1}^2 >= R_n (smallest prime factor of a new composite divides an element of the previous row's composite interval). Rows 5..6000 checked by simulating the definition (rows.c); n > 6000 by mod-210 sieve bounds l_j <= (210/162)(j+48), l_{n-1} >= n - 49 - (24/162)(n+46) (tail_ineq.py). Outside Lean: the simulation of rows 5..6000 and the paper induction.
